PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED:

2010-06-02 | 1236 m MD | Tipam | gas_show | low | 1.6 hrs NPT
Cause: Background gas rise while drilling Tipam, connection gas trending up.
Remedy: Increased mud weight slightly, monitored trend, continued drilling.

2010-06-03 | 1620 m MD | Barail | cementing_issue | medium | 6.0 hrs NPT
Cause: Poor cement bond / losses during primary cementing of casing shoe in Barail.
Remedy: Squeeze cemented shoe track, pressure tested to spec before drilling out.

2010-06-03 | 1645 m MD | Barail | overpressure | high | 7.7 hrs NPT
Cause: SPP trend increasing and drag rising while drilling into Barail, suspected transition zone.
Remedy: Raised mud weight in 26-ppg steps, monitored trip gas, continued drilling with caution.

2010-06-04 | 1916 m MD | Barail | overpressure | critical | 30.3 hrs NPT
Cause: SPP trend increasing and drag rising while drilling into Barail, suspected transition zone.
Remedy: Raised mud weight in 41-ppg steps, monitored trip gas, continued drilling with caution.

2010-06-05 | 2208 m MD | Barail | overpressure | medium | 2.8 hrs NPT
Cause: Well kicked back while circulating out of Barail, gas readings elevated on trip gas.
Remedy: Weighted mud up to balance formation pressure, circulated bottoms up before resuming.

2010-06-07 | 2659 m MD | Kopili | kick | critical | 25.2 hrs NPT
Cause: Gas-cut mud and increasing pit volume observed drilling Kopili, well flowing.
Remedy: Hard shut-in, recorded SIDPP/SICP, weighted up mud and circulated bottoms up.
